name: entrevistas_agent
description: Prepares a complete interview kit for a given candidate and optionally sends a contact email (as a draft-then-send flow). Receives the candidate profile directly in the request payload. Supports CV text for inflation detection.
when_to_use: When the user wants to: (1) prepare an interview for a specific candidate (internal ATS or external from Himalayas), generate tailored questions, or produce the interview kit document — use action 'preparar_entrevista'. (2) draft a contact email to a candidate about an open position AFTER the kit has already been prepared, WITHOUT sending it — use action 'redactar_email', then show the draft to the user for confirmation. (3) actually send the previously drafted and confirmed email — use action 'enviar_email'. For external candidates (no email/experiencia in system), use profile_url for web search to gather contact info.

actions.name: preparar_entrevista
actions.description: Orchestrates the full interview preparation flow: web search, CV inflation detection (if cv_texto provided), question generation, and kit production as a Word document. Does NOT send any email — use 'enviar_email' action separately for that.

request_schema.candidato_id: UUID string or 'external-<candidate_id>' for Himalayas candidates

candidato.email: string (optional — not available for external/Himalayas candidates; pass empty string)
candidato.cv_texto: string (optional) — full plain text of the candidate CV. Include this when the user uploads a CV file. The orchestrator must extract the text from the file and pass it here.
candidato.profile_url: string (optional but strongly recommended for external candidates — used for web search to find contact info)

actions.name: redactar_email
actions.description: Drafts (asunto + cuerpo) a contact email for a candidate about an open position, WITHOUT sending it. Use this ONLY after 'preparar_entrevista' has already been called. The orchestrator must show the returned draft to the user and get explicit confirmation before calling 'enviar_email'.

actions.name: enviar_email
actions.description: Sends a contact email to a candidate about an open position. Use this ONLY after the user has seen and confirmed the draft from 'redactar_email' — pass that exact 'asunto' and 'cuerpo_email' through. Never regenerates the kit.

request_schema.asunto: string — exact subject the user confirmed (from 'redactar_email', possibly edited)
request_schema.cuerpo_email: string — exact body the user confirmed (from 'redactar_email', possibly edited)

conventions.cv_handling: When the user uploads a CV file, the orchestrator extracts the text and includes it in the conversation context. Pass this extracted text in 'candidato.cv_texto'. Never pass cv_base64 — always use plain text.
conventions.email_behavior: Two-step, draft-then-send: call 'redactar_email' first, show the draft to the user, get explicit confirmation, then call 'enviar_email' passing the confirmed 'asunto'/'cuerpo_email' — never call 'enviar_email' without a shown-and-confirmed draft. Never pass 'enviar_email: true' to 'preparar_entrevista' — that field is ignored.
conventions.web_search: Non-blocking. Continues with CV data if no results found.
conventions.state: Stateless. Candidate profile must be in the request payload.
conventions.supabase: Not used. guardado_en_supabase is always false.
